class Solution:
    def rearrangeArray(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        nums.sort()
        ans = []
        while nums:
            distinct = list(set(nums))
            ans.extend(distinct[:-1])  # add all elements except the last one
            nums = nums[nums.index(distinct[-1]) + 1:]  # remove the last element and the ones before it
            if nums:  # if nums is not empty
                distinct.sort()
                ans.append(distinct[0])  # add the first distinct element after sorting
        return ans
